Debt Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for information about short-term and long-term debt arrangements, which includes amounts of borrowings under each line of credit, note payable, commercial paper issue, bonds indenture, debenture issue, own-share lending arrangements and any other contractual agreement to repay funds, and about the underlying arrangements, rationale for a classification as long-term, including repayment terms, interest rates, collateral provided, restrictions on use of assets and activities, whether or not in compliance with debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements, such as the effects of refinancing and noncompliance with debt covenants.

role.label: belfa_DebtInstrumentAdditionalBorrowingCapacity
role.documentation: Amount of additional borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

role.label: Debt Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of debt instrument, including, but not limited to, draws against credit facilities.

role.label: us-gaap_DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1
role.terseLabel: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
role.documentation: Percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the debt instrument.

role.label: us-gaap_DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount
role.documentation: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

role.label: belfa_DebtInstrumentMaximumPrincipalBorrowingCapacityInForeignCurrencies
role.terseLabel: Debt Instrument, Maximum Principal Borrowing Capacity in Foreign Currencies
role.documentation: Maximum borrowing capacity in foreign currencies under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

role.label: Debt Instrument, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The name for the particular debt instrument or borrowing that distinguishes it from other debt instruments or borrowings, including draws against credit facilities.

role.label: Schedule of Long-Term Debt Instruments [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about long-term debt instrument or arrangement.

role.label: us-gaap_DebtInstrumentVariableInterestRateTypeExtensibleEnumeration
role.terseLabel: Debt Instrument, Variable Interest Rate, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
role.documentation: Indicates type of variable interest rate on debt instrument.

role.label: Held to maturity U.S. Treasury securities
role.documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

role.label: us-gaap_DebtWeightedAverageInterestRate
role.documentation: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

role.label: belfa_DeferredCompensationArrangementVestingAge
role.documentation: The age of employees for contributions to become fully vested under deferred compensation arrangement.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCompensationExpense
role.terseLabel: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
role.documentation: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredCompensationPlanAssets
role.documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

role.label: Federal, deferred
role.documentation: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

role.label: Foreign, deferred
role.documentation: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredIncomeTaxAssetsNet
role.documentation: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilitiesNet
role.documentation: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

role.label: Deferred income taxes benefit/(expense)
role.documentation: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

role.label: State, deferred
role.documentation: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsGoodwillAndIntangibleAssets
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsGross
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Lease accounting
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from lease accounting.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsNet
role.documentation: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

role.label: Federal, state and foreign net operating loss and credit carryforwards
role.terseLabel: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsOther
role.documentation: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsPropertyPlantAndEquipment
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.label: State tax credits
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from state taxes.

role.label: Reserves and accruals
role.documentation: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxLiabilities
role.documentation: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxLiabilitiesGoodwillAndIntangibleAssets
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxLiabilitiesLeasingArrangements
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxLiabilitiesOther
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

role.label: us-gaap_DeferredTaxLiabilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

role.label: belfa_DeferredTaxLiabilitiesUnfundedPensionLiability
role.documentation: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from unfunded pension liability.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObligation
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
role.documentation: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

role.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

role.label: Net loss
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

role.label: Prior service cost
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

role.label: Actuarial loss (gain)
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfGainsLosses
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Discount rate, benefit obligation
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Rate of compensation increase, benefit obligation
role.documentation: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

role.label: Discount rate, net periodic benefit cost
role.documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

role.label: Rate of compensation increase, net periodic benefit cost
role.documentation: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligation
role.documentation: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligationBenefitsPaid
role.documentation: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

role.label: Company contributions
role.documentation: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsFiveFiscalYearsThereafter
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsNextTwelveMonths
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsYearFive
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsYearFour
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsYearThree
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureBenefitPaymentsYearTwo
role.documentation: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureEmployerContributionsNextFiscalYear
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
role.documentation: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssets
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount, Ending Balance
role.documentation: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

role.label: Underfunded status, December 31
role.documentation: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

role.label: Interest Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanNetPeriodicBenefitCost
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
role.documentation: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

role.label: belfa_DefinedBenefitPlanNumberOfMonthlyPayments
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Number of Monthly Payments
role.documentation: Refers to number of monthly payments an employee is entitled to receive under the defined benefit plan.

role.label: belfa_DefinedBenefitPlanPercentageOfAverageBaseCompensationFiveConsecutiveYearsNormalRetirement
role.terseLabel: Defined Benefit Plan, Percentage of Average Base Compensation Five Consecutive Years, Normal Retirement
role.documentation: The percentage of average base compensation of the highest five consecutive years for normal retirement under defined benefit plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsBenefitsPaid
role.documentation: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

role.label: Service Cost
role.documentation: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedContributionPlanCostRecognized
role.documentation: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingContributionPercent
role.terseLabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
role.documentation: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

role.label: belfa_DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingContributionPercentOfMatchFirst1EmployeeContribution
role.terseLabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent Of Match, First 1% Employee Contribution
role.documentation: Percentage employer matches of the employee's first 1% contribution matched.

role.label: belfa_DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingContributionPercentOfMatchNext5EmployeeContribution
role.terseLabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Match, Next 5% Employee Contribution
role.documentation: Percentage employer matches of the employee's next 5% contribution matched.

role.label: us-gaap_DefinedContributionPlanMaximumAnnualContributionsPerEmployeePercent
role.terseLabel: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Percent
role.documentation: Maximum percentage of employee gross pay the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

role.label: us-gaap_Depreciation
role.documentation: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

role.label: Depreciation and amortization
role.documentation: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

role.label: Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property and equipment costs, including methods used and estimated useful lives and how impairment of such assets is assessed and recognized.

role.label: Derivative Asset, Statement of Financial Position
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative asset.

role.label: Total derivative assets
role.documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

role.label: us-gaap_DerivativeAssetsLiabilitiesAtFairValueNet
role.terseLabel: Derivative Assets (Liabilities), at Fair Value, Net
role.documentation: Fair values as of the balance sheet date of the net amount of all assets and liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments.

role.label: us-gaap_DerivativeBasisSpreadOnVariableRate
role.terseLabel: Derivative, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
role.documentation: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the interest rate derivative.

role.label: Derivative Contract [Domain]
role.documentation: Financial instrument or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

role.label: us-gaap_DerivativeFixedInterestRate
role.documentation: Fixed interest rate related to the interest rate derivative.

role.label: Derivative Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of derivative contract.

role.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for derivative instruments and hedging activities including, but not limited to, risk management strategies, non-hedging derivative instruments, assets, liabilities, revenue and expenses, and methodologies and assumptions used in determining the amounts.

role.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities Disclosures [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about derivatives and hedging activities.

role.label: Non designated as hedging instruments
role.documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

role.label: us-gaap_DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
role.documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

role.label: Not designated as hedging instruments
role.documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

role.label: Total derivative liabilities
role.documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

role.label: Derivative Liability, Statement of Financial Position
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative liability.

role.label: us-gaap_DerivativeNotionalAmount
role.documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

role.label: Derivatives, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for its derivative instruments and hedging activities.

role.label: Developed Technology Rights [Member]
role.documentation: Rights to developed technology, which can include the right to develop, use, market, sell, or offer for sale products, compounds, or intellectual property.

role.label: Disaggregation of Revenue [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about disaggregation of revenue into categories depicting how nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flows are affected by economic factor.

role.label: Disaggregation of Revenue [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of disaggregation of revenue into categories depicting how nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flows are affected by economic factor.

role.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: us-gaap_DividendsCommonStock
role.documentation: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

role.label: Less dividends declared
role.negatedLabel: Cash dividends declared on common stock
role.documentation: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

role.label: Document Annual Report
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as an annual report.

role.label: Document Financial Statement Error Correction [Flag]
role.documentation: Indicates whether any of the financial statement period in the filing include a restatement due to error correction.

role.label: Document Fiscal Period Focus
role.documentation: Fiscal period values are FY, Q1, Q2, and Q3. 1st, 2nd and 3rd quarter 10-Q or 10-QT statements have value Q1, Q2, and Q3 respectively, with 10-K, 10-KT or other fiscal year statements having FY.

role.label: Document Fiscal Year Focus
role.documentation: This is focus fiscal year of the document report in YYYY format. For a 2006 annual report, which may also provide financial information from prior periods, fiscal 2006 should be given as the fiscal year focus. Example: 2006.

role.label: Document Information [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Document Information [Table]
role.documentation: Container to support the formal attachment of each official or unofficial, public or private document as part of a submission package.

role.label: Document Period End Date
role.documentation: For the EDGAR submission types of Form 8-K: the date of the report, the date of the earliest event reported; for the EDGAR submission types of Form N-1A: the filing date; for all other submission types: the end of the reporting or transition period. The format of the date is YYYY-MM-DD.

role.label: Document Transition Report
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true only for a form used as a transition report.

role.label: Document Type
role.documentation: The type of document being provided (such as 10-K, 10-Q, 485BPOS, etc). The document type is limited to the same value as the supporting SEC submission type, or the word 'Other'.

role.label: EMEA [Member]
role.documentation: Regions of Europe, Middle East and Africa.

role.label: EOS Claim From Principal Commissioner of Customs [Member]
role.documentation: Related to EOS claim from principal commissioner of customs.

role.label: EOS Power Panama Inc. [Member]
role.documentation: Represents EOS Power Panama Inc.

role.label: Net earnings per common share, basic (in dollars per share)
role.terseLabel: Net earnings per share, basic (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Net earnings per common share, diluted (in dollars per share)
role.terseLabel: Net earnings per share, diluted (in dollars per share)
role.documentation: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

role.label: Earnings Per Share, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for computing basic and diluted earnings or loss per share for each class of common stock and participating security. Addresses all significant policy factors, including any antidilutive items that have been excluded from the computation and takes into account stock dividends, splits and reverse splits that occur after the balance sheet date of the latest reporting period but before the issuance of the financial statements.

role.label: belfa_EarnoutAdjustment
role.documentation: The amount related to the earnout adjustment.

role.label: Earnout Payment [Member]
role.documentation: Relating to earnout payment.

role.label: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations
role.documentation: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAdjustmentsToTransitionTaxAmount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to adjustments to transition tax.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAdjustmentsToTransitionTaxPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to adjustments to transition tax.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate
role.terseLabel: U.S. Federal statutory income tax rate, percent
role.documentation: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationChangeInDeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefits
role.documentation: Represents the amount of change in unrecognized tax benefits under an effective income tax rate reconciliation.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionIntercompanyBadDebtAmount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to intercompany bad debt.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionIntercompanyBadDebtPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for intercompany bad debt.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionSection162LimitationAmount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the section 162 limitation.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionSection162LimitationPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for section 162 limitation.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionsDividends
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdiiAmount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax benefit from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived intangible income (FDII).

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdiiPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax benefit from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived intangible income (FDII).

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationForeignIncomeTaxRateDifferential
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiAmount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI).

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationNondeductibleExpenseLifeInsurance
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to life insurance expense.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationNondeductibleExpenseShareBasedCompensationCost
role.documentation: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationNontaxableOrNondeductibleItemsOtherAmount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to othe4 nontaxable or nondeductible items.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationNontaxableOrNondeductibleItemsOtherPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nontaxable or nondeductible items.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherReconcilingItemsPercent
role.documentation: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to other reconciling items. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationPriorYearIncomeTaxes
role.terseLabel: Adjustments relating to prior years, percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationStateAndLocalIncomeTaxes
role.terseLabel: State and local income taxes, net of federal income tax effect, percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about income tax rate reconciliation between amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operation to amount of income tax expense(benefit) that would result from applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation.

role.label: belfa_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditsResearchPercentage
role.terseLabel: Research and development tax credits, percent
role.documentation: Represents the percentage of research tax credits under an effective income tax rate reconciliation.

role.label: us-gaap_EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxExemptIncome
role.negatedTerseLabel: Nontaxable controlled foreign corporation ("CFC") income, percent
role.documentation: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

role.label: Salaries, bonuses and related benefits
role.documentation: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

role.label: us-gaap_EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedPeriodForRecognition1
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Year)
role.documentation: Weighted-average period over which cost not yet recognized is expected to be recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: us-gaap_EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions
role.terseLabel: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Excluding Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of cost to be recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

role.label: Employee Severance [Member]
role.documentation: Termination of an employee associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a plan.

role.label: Enercon Technologies, Ltd [Member]
role.documentation: In reference to Enercon Technologies, Ltd.

role.label: Entity Address, Address Line One
role.documentation: Address Line 1 such as Attn, Building Name, Street Name

role.label: Entity Address, City or Town
role.documentation: Name of the City or Town

role.label: Entity Address, Postal Zip Code
role.documentation: Code for the postal or zip code

role.label: Entity Address, State or Province
role.documentation: Name of the state or province.

role.label: Entity Central Index Key
role.documentation: A unique 10-digit SEC-issued value to identify entities that have filed disclosures with the SEC. It is commonly abbreviated as CIK.

role.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
role.documentation: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

role.label: Entity Current Reporting Status
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' whether registrants (1) have filed all reports required to be filed by Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that registrants were required to file such reports), and (2) have been subject to such filing requirements for the past 90 days. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.label: Entity [Domain]
role.documentation: All the names of the entities being reported upon in a document. Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. Some examples of such structures are corporations, partnerships, limited liability companies, grantor trusts, and other trusts. This item does not include business and geographical segments which are included in the geographical or business segments domains.

role.label: Entity Emerging Growth Company
role.documentation: Indicate if registrant meets the emerging growth company criteria.

role.label: Entity File Number
role.documentation: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

role.label: Entity Filer Category
role.documentation: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.documentation: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

role.label: Entity Interactive Data Current
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was required to submit such files).

role.label: Entity Public Float
role.documentation: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

role.label: Entity Registrant Name
role.documentation: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

role.label: Entity Shell Company
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant is a shell company as defined in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act.

role.label: Entity Small Business
role.documentation: Indicates that the company is a Smaller Reporting Company (SRC).

role.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
role.documentation: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

role.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

role.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

role.label: Equity Component [Domain]
role.documentation: Components of equity are the parts of the total Equity balance including that which is allocated to common, preferred, treasury stock, retained earnings, etc.

role.label: Investment, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Name of investment including named security. Excludes entity that is consolidated.

role.label: us-gaap_EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment
role.negatedLabel: Impairment of equity method investment and related party notes
role.documentation: Amount of other-than-temporary decline in value that has been recognized against investment accounted for under equity method of accounting.

role.label: Estimate of Fair Value Measurement [Member]
role.documentation: Measured as an estimate of fair value.

role.label: Europe [Member]
role.documentation: Continent of Europe.

role.label: belfa_ExcessiveDividendRateOfClassBOverClassA
role.terseLabel: Excessive Dividend Rate of Class B Over Class A
role.documentation: Dividend rate of class B in excess of dividend rate of class A.

role.label: belfa_ExcessiveUndistributedEarningsAllocationRateOfClassBOverClassA
role.terseLabel: Excessive Undistributed Earnings Allocation Rate of Class B Over Class A
role.documentation: Undistributed earnings allocated to class B of common stock in excess of earnings allocated to class A.

role.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring and Nonrecurring Basis [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of assets measured at fair value measured on a recurring or nonrecurring basis. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value measurements recorded and the reasons for the measurements, level within the fair value hierarchy in which the fair value measurements are categorized and transfers between levels 1 and 2.

role.label: Asset Class [Domain]
role.documentation: Class of asset.

role.label: Asset Class [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by class of asset.

role.label: Fair Value, by Balance Sheet Grouping [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about the fair value of financial instruments, including financial assets and financial liabilities, and the measurements of those instruments, assets, and liabilities.

role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by level within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient.

role.label: Measurement Basis [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by measurement basis.

role.label: Measurement Frequency [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by measurement frequency.

role.label: Fair Value Disclosures [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for the fair value of financial instruments (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined), and the measurements of those instruments as well as disclosures related to the fair value of non-financial assets and liabilities. Such disclosures about the financial instruments, assets, and liabilities would include: (1) the fair value of the required items together with their carrying amounts (as appropriate); (2) for items for which it is not practicable to estimate fair value, disclosure would include: (a) information pertinent to estimating fair value (including, carrying amount, effective interest rate, and maturity, and (b) the reasons why it is not practicable to estimate fair value; (3) significant concentrations of credit risk including: (a) information about the activity, region, or economic characteristics identifying a concentration, (b) the maximum amount of loss the entity is exposed to based on the gross fair value of the related item, (c) policy for requiring collateral or other security and information as to accessing such collateral or security, and (d) the nature and brief description of such collateral or security; (4) quantitative information about market risks and how such risks are managed; (5) for items measured on both a recurring and nonrecurring basis information regarding the inputs used to develop the fair value measurement; and (6) for items presented in the financial statement for which fair value measurement is elected: (a) information necessary to understand the reasons for the election, (b) discussion of the effect of fair value changes on earnings, (c) a description of [similar groups] items for which the election is made and the relation thereof to the balance sheet, the aggregate carrying value of items included in the balance sheet that are not eligible for the election; (7) all other required (as defined) and desired information.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 1 [Member]
role.documentation: Quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the reporting entity can access at the measurement date.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 2 [Member]
role.documentation: Inputs other than quoted prices included within level 1 that are observable for an asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, or quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in inactive markets.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 3 [Member]
role.documentation: Unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

role.label: Measurement Frequency [Domain]
role.documentation: Measurement frequency.

role.label: Fair Value Measurement, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for fair value measurements of financial and non-financial assets, liabilities and instruments classified in shareholders' equity. Disclosures include, but are not limited to, how an entity that manages a group of financial assets and liabilities on the basis of its net exposure measures the fair value of those assets and liabilities.

role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Domain]
role.documentation: Categories used to prioritize the inputs to valuation techniques to measure fair value.

role.label: Fair Value, Nonrecurring [Member]
role.documentation: Infrequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, not frequently measured at fair value.

role.label: Federal and State and Local Authority [Member]
role.documentation: Designated tax departments of the federal, state, and local governments that are entitled to levy and collect income taxes from the entity.

role.label: Fed Funds Effective Rate Overnight Index Swap Rate [Member]
role.documentation: Fixed rate on U.S. dollar, constant-notional interest rate swap having its variable-rate leg referenced to Federal Funds effective rate with no additional spread over Federal Funds effective rate on that variable-rate leg.

role.label: FF3 [Member]
role.documentation: Relating to FF3.

role.label: Interest on lease liabilities - finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

role.label: Operating cash flows from finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

role.label: us-gaap_FinanceLeaseLiability
role.terseLabel: Finance leases, Present value of lease liabilities
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

role.label: us-gaap_FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes current finance lease liability.

role.label: us-gaap_FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position
role.documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes noncurrent finance lease liability.

role.label: us-gaap_FinanceLeaseLiabilityPaymentsDue
role.totalLabel: Finance leases, Total undiscounted cash flows
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

role.label: 2026, finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

role.label: Finance leases, Thereafter
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.label: 2030, finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.label: 2029, finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.label: 2028, finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.label: 2027, finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

role.label: us-gaap_FinanceLeaseLiabilityUndiscountedExcessAmount
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

role.label: Finance cash flows from finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

role.label: Amortization of ROU assets - finance leases
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

role.label: Finance leases
role.documentation: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

role.label: Finance leases (in years) (Year)
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining lease term for finance lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Financial Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of financial instrument.

role.label: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived and Indefinite-Lived [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets acquired in business combination.

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife
role.documentation: Useful life of finite-lived intangible assets, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Accumulated amortization
role.documentation: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseNextTwelveMonths
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearFive
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearFour
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearThree
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearTwo
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets by Major Class [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by major type or class of finite-lived intangible assets.

role.label: Gross carrying amount
role.documentation: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Major Class Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The major class of finite-lived intangible asset (for example, patents, trademarks, copyrights, etc.) A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar, either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

role.label: us-gaap_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet
role.documentation: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: Definite lived intangible assets acquired
role.documentation: Amount of increase in assets, excluding financial assets, lacking physical substance with a definite life, from an acquisition.

role.label: Foreign Tax Jurisdiction [Member]
role.documentation: Designated foreign jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax outside country of domicile.

role.label: us-gaap_ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBeforeTax
role.terseLabel: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

role.label: us-gaap_ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealized
role.negatedLabel: Net unrealized (gains)/losses on foreign currency revaluation
role.documentation: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

role.label: Foreign Currency Transactions and Translations Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for (1) transactions denominated in a currency other than the reporting enterprise's functional currency, (2) translating foreign currency financial statements that are incorporated into the financial statements of the reporting enterprise by consolidation, combination, or the equity method of accounting, and (3) remeasurement of the financial statements of a foreign reporting enterprise in a hyperinflationary economy.

role.label: Foreign Exchange Forward [Member]
role.documentation: Foreign exchange forward traded on an exchange (examples include but are not limited to the International Securities Exchange, Philadelphia Stock Exchange, or the Chicago Mercantile Exchange) for options or future contracts to buy or sell a certain currency, at a specified date, at a fixed exercise exchange rate.

role.label: Forward Rate [Member]
role.documentation: Relating to forward rate.

role.label: Full Achievement of Earnout [Member]
role.documentation: Relating to the full achievement of Earnout.

role.label: Gain on sale of Czech Republic business
role.negatedLabel: Gain on sale of Czech Republic business
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

role.label: us-gaap_GainLossOnSaleOfProperties
role.documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

role.label: us-gaap_GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
role.negatedLabel: Gains on sale/disposal of property, plant and equipment
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

role.label: belfa_GainOnDerecognitionOfCallOptionLiability
role.terseLabel: Gain on Derecognition of Call Option Liability
role.documentation: The gain resulting from the derecognition of the call option liability.

role.label: Geographic Concentration Risk [Member]
role.documentation: Reflects the percentage that a specified dollar value on the balance sheet or income statement in the period from one or more specified geographic areas is to a corresponding consolidated, segment, or product line amount. Risk is the materially adverse effects of economic decline or antagonistic political actions resulting in loss of assets, sales volume, labor supply, or source of materials and supplies in a US state or a specified country, continent, or region such as EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa).

role.label: Goodwill
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: Goodwill allocation related to acquisition
role.documentation: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

role.label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill and intangible assets. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill and intangible assets.

role.label: Goodwill Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for goodwill.

role.label: Foreign currency translation
role.documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: us-gaap_GoodwillGross
role.documentation: Amount, before accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized. Includes amount, before amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill for private company.

role.label: us-gaap_GoodwillImpairedAccumulatedImpairmentLoss
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: us-gaap_GoodwillImpairmentLoss
role.documentation: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: Gross profit
role.documentation: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

role.label: us-gaap_HeldToMaturitySecurities
role.terseLabel: Held to maturity U.S. Treasury securities, amortized cost
role.documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

role.label: us-gaap_HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAccumulatedUnrecognizedHoldingGain
role.terseLabel: Held to maturity U.S. Treasury securities, gross unrealized gains
role.documentation: Amount of accumulated unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

role.label: us-gaap_HeldToMaturitySecuritiesFairValue
role.terseLabel: Held to maturity U.S. Treasury securities, fair value
role.documentation: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

role.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of information about investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

role.label: His Majesty's Revenue and Customs (HMRC) [Member]
role.documentation: Designated tax department of the government of United Kingdom.

role.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Asset Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The name of the impaired asset to be disposed of by a method other than sale.

role.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale by Type [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of impaired long-lived asset to be disposed of by method other than sale.

role.label: Impairment of CUI tradename
role.documentation: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of an intangible asset (excluding goodwill) to fair value.

role.label: us-gaap_ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefinitelivedExcludingGoodwill
role.terseLabel: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill)
role.documentation: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.

role.label: Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing and measuring the impairment of long-lived assets. An entity also may disclose its accounting policy for long-lived assets to be sold. This policy excludes goodwill and intangible assets.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest
role.totalLabel: Earnings before provision for income taxes
role.documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesForeign
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

role.label: Statement of Income Location, Balance [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

role.label: Statement of Income Location, Balance [Domain]
role.documentation: Location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Domain]
role.documentation: Income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Authority, Name [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by name of taxing authority.

role.label: Income Tax Authority, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Named agency, division or body that levies income taxes, examines tax returns for compliance, or grants exemptions from or makes other decisions pertaining to income taxes.

role.label: Income Tax Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for income tax.

role.label: Provision for income taxes
role.documentation: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.label: belfa_IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitOnReversalOfInterestAndPenalties
role.terseLabel: Income Tax Expense (Benefit) on Reversal of Interest and Penalties
role.documentation: The amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) recognized on reversal of interest and penalties pertaining to continuing operations.

role.label: Federal
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.label: Foreign income tax paid
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.label: State and Local
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

role.label: Income Tax, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for income taxes, which may include its accounting policies for recognizing and measuring deferred tax assets and liabilities and related valuation allowances, recognizing investment tax credits, operating loss carryforwards, tax credit carryforwards, and other carryforwards, methodologies for determining its effective income tax rate and the characterization of interest and penalties in the financial statements.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationChangeInDeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsDividends
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationForeignIncomeTaxRateDifferential
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate
role.terseLabel: U.S. Federal statutory income tax rate, amount
role.documentation: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpenseLifeInsurance
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpenseShareBasedCompensationCost
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationOtherAdjustments
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationOtherReconcilingItems
role.documentation: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationPriorYearIncomeTaxes
role.terseLabel: Adjustments relating to prior years, amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationStateAndLocalIncomeTaxes
role.terseLabel: State and local income taxes, net of federal income tax effect, amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: belfa_IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsResearchAmount
role.terseLabel: Research and development tax credits, amount
role.documentation: Represents the amount of research tax credits reported under a income tax reconciliation.

role.label: us-gaap_IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxExemptIncome
role.negatedTerseLabel: Nontaxable controlled foreign corporation ("CFC") income, amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

role.label: belfa_IncomeTaxReductionFromCapitalizedResearchAndDevelopmentExpenditures
role.terseLabel: Income Tax Reduction From Capitalized Research and Development Expenditures
role.documentation: The amount of income tax reduction from the capitalized research and development expenditures.

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

role.label: belfa_IncreaseDecreaseInCashSurrenderValue

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerAsset
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInInventories

us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssets

role.label: us-gaap_IncreaseDecreaseInRestructuringReserve

role.label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Axis]

role.label: us-gaap_IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwill

role.label: belfa_IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAmortization

role.label: Indefinite lived intangible assets acquired

role.label: belfa_IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwillNet

role.label: belfa_IntangibleAssetsPercentOfTotalAssets

role.label: Inventories

role.label: Inventory, Policy [Policy Text Block]
